# ADR-008: Reuse the original proper-warp guard at the native mutation boundary

Status: chosen_for_uncloak_guard

Concerns: Q-behavior, Q-state, Q-reproduce

## Decision

Extract the existing OriginalParkProjection::uncloak_ball condition and adapt its mode/stamp field reads through the native runtime. Wrap the existing set_massive and sensor-membership statements together using a recorded syntax transformation.

## Rationale

The existing guard expresses the original IsWarpish/IsAligningForWarp relation for signed integer stamps. Reuse preserves prior verified specification work and removes a known native fixture mismatch without duplicating projection storage.

## Alternatives

Copy the bounded projection into production; handwrite a separate cloak state machine; treat all states as non-warp.

## Consequences

The unchanged proper-warp original fixture passes natively. Full cloak input domains, sensor semantics, warp trajectories and formal production correspondence remain open.
